description: Traffic Counts is a dataset listed in City of Mesa open data portal (citydata.mesaaz.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Mesa. The Average Weekday Traffic Volume is a count of the number of vehicle axle pairs (a car has 2 axles) passing through a given location on an average weekday. This is the traffic volume over a one-day weekday period and is a summary of the data that is collected in 15-minute intervals. Coverage: Mesa, Arizona. The portal files it under the category Planes, Trains & Automobiles. Its tags are traffic, transportation, axle, traffic counts. The table has 16 columns. Attribution on the portal: Transportation. The portal shows 2018-03-21 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-citydata-mesaaz-gov-portal.
